verdict.rationale: Together AI documents an official 'Docs MCP server' that gives coding agents live access to its documentation site, alongside agent 'skills' for correct SDK usage — a genuine first-party MCP server an agent can connect to. However, this MCP server is scoped narrowly to docs lookup rather than exposing broader platform capabilities (inference, fine-tuning, dedicated endpoints) as MCP tools. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader MCP server surface beyond docs lookup, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP server working in practice.
